sloka: सम्प्रस्रवंस्तदा मेदः शोणितं च महाबलः।वध्यमानो नगेन्द्राग्रैर्भक्षयामास वानरान् ।। ६.६७.९८ ।।
transliteration: samprasravaṁstadā medaḥ śoṇitaṁ ca mahābalaḥ।vadhyamāno nagendrāgrairbhakṣayāmāsa vānarān ।। 6.67.98 ।।

translations.english: Then the mighty Kumbhakarna while being struck by peaks of mountains, he was feasting on Vanaras fat and blood oozing out from his mouth.
